epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration with a payment gateway (Stripe) for credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event handling

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for secure credit card transactions
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Implement Stripe payment gateway API integration
tasks.description: Set up Stripe API keys, configure payment processing, and handle payment responses

tasks.title: Develop a secure payment form for credit card input
tasks.description: Create a payment form that collects credit card information and submits it to the Stripe API

tasks.title: Test payment processing with sample credit card data
tasks.description: Verify that the payment processing works correctly with different payment scenarios

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Implement subscription management features using Stripe's subscription API
acceptance_criteria: The system allows customers to update their subscription plans and billing information
The system cancels subscriptions and notifies customers when a cancellation is requested

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe's subscription API for plan management
tasks.description: Configure subscription plans, handle plan updates, and manage billing cycles

tasks.title: Develop a subscription management dashboard for customers
tasks.description: Create a dashboard that displays subscription information and allows customers to make changes

tasks.title: Test subscription updates and cancellations with sample data
tasks.description: Verify that subscription management features work correctly with different scenarios

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can track payment activity and handle issues
stories.description: Implement webhook handling for payment events and generate receipts and email notifications
acceptance_criteria: The system receives and processes payment event webhooks from Stripe
The system generates receipts and sends email notifications for successful payments

tasks.title: Configure Stripe webhooks for payment event notifications
tasks.description: Set up webhook endpoints and handle payment event notifications

tasks.title: Develop a receipt generation feature for successful payments
tasks.description: Create a feature that generates receipts and stores them in the system

tasks.title: Implement email notifications for payment receipts and events
tasks.description: Configure email templates and send notifications for payment receipts and events

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access my account securely
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, and authenticate them securely
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate user credentials and authenticate users correctly
The system should handle incorrect login attempts and display an error message
The system should redirect authenticated users to their dashboard

tasks.title: Implement email and password login functionality
tasks.description: Create a login form that accepts email and password, and authenticates users using a backend API

tasks.title: Integrate with authentication API
tasks.description: Integrate the login form with a backend authentication API to validate user credentials

tasks.title: Implement login error handling and redirection
tasks.description: Handle incorrect login attempts, display error messages, and redirect authenticated users to their dashboard

stories.title: As a new user, I want to signup for an account, so that I can use the system
stories.description: The system should allow new users to signup for an account, and send a verification email to their registered email address
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate user input and create a new user account
The system should send a verification email to the user's registered email address
The system should allow users to verify their email address and activate their account

tasks.title: Implement user signup form
tasks.description: Create a signup form that accepts user input and validates it

tasks.title: Integrate with email service to send verification emails
tasks.description: Integrate the system with an email service to send verification emails to new users

tasks.title: Implement email verification and account activation
tasks.description: Allow users to verify their email address and activate their account

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover access to my account
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, and send a password reset link to their registered email address
acceptance_criteria: The system should validate user input and send a password reset link to the user's registered email address
The system should allow users to reset their password using the password reset link
The system should update the user's password and authenticate them securely

tasks.title: Implement password reset form
tasks.description: Create a password reset form that accepts user input and validates it

tasks.title: Integrate with email service to send password reset links
tasks.description: Integrate the system with an email service to send password reset links to users

tasks.title: Implement password reset functionality
tasks.description: Allow users to reset their password using the password reset link, and update their password securely

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using OAuth, so that I can access my account securely using social media
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth integration with Google and GitHub
acceptance_criteria: The system should redirect users to the OAuth authorization page
The system should handle OAuth authorization code and authenticate users securely
The system should redirect authenticated users to their dashboard

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login functionality with Google
tasks.description: Integrate the system with Google OAuth API to allow users to login using their Google account

tasks.title: Implement OAuth login functionality with GitHub
tasks.description: Integrate the system with GitHub OAuth API to allow users to login using their GitHub account

tasks.title: Implement OAuth authorization code handling and user authentication
tasks.description: Handle OAuth authorization code, authenticate users securely, and redirect them to their dashboard

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users for important events

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive welcome emails, so that I feel engaged with the platform
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to new users with a personalized message and a link to get started
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a welcome email to new users within 1 minute of registration
The welcome email contains the user's name and a personalized message
The welcome email link redirects to the platform's dashboard

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome emails
tasks.description: Design and implement a reusable email template for welcome emails

tasks.title: Integrate welcome email sending with user registration
tasks.description: Modify the user registration workflow to trigger the sending of welcome emails

tasks.title: Test and validate welcome email functionality
tasks.description: Test the welcome email sending functionality with different user scenarios and edge cases

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive password reset links, so that I can recover my account
stories.description: The system should send a password reset link to users who request it, allowing them to reset their password
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a password reset link to the user's email within 1 minute of request
The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used to reset the password
The password reset link redirects to the platform's password reset page

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation and sending
tasks.description: Generate and send a password reset link to the user's email when requested

tasks.title: Implement password reset functionality
tasks.description: Allow users to reset their password using the password reset link

tasks.title: Test and validate password reset functionality
tasks.description: Test the password reset functionality with different user scenarios and edge cases

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive payment receipts, so that I can track my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt to users after a successful payment, containing the transaction details
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a payment receipt to the user's email within 1 minute of successful payment
The payment receipt contains the transaction details, including date, amount, and payment method
The payment receipt is in a readable format and can be printed or saved by the user

tasks.title: Implement payment receipt generation and sending
tasks.description: Generate and send a payment receipt to the user's email after a successful payment

tasks.title: Integrate payment receipt sending with payment processing
tasks.description: Modify the payment processing workflow to trigger the sending of payment receipts

tasks.title: Test and validate payment receipt functionality
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt sending functionality with different payment scenarios and edge cases

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to integrate the email notification system with SendGrid or AWS SES, so that I can reliably send emails
stories.description: The system should integrate with a reliable email service provider to send transactional emails
acceptance_criteria: The system can send emails using SendGrid or AWS SES
The system can handle email sending failures and retries
The system can track email sending metrics, such as delivery rates and bounce rates

tasks.title: Research and choose an email service provider
tasks.description: Research and choose between SendGrid and AWS SES for email sending

tasks.title: Implement integration with the chosen email service provider
tasks.description: Implement the integration with the chosen email service provider, including setup and configuration

tasks.title: Test and validate email sending functionality with the chosen provider
tasks.description: Test the email sending functionality with the chosen provider, including handling failures and retries

acceptance_criteria: The admin can create a new user with a valid username and password
The admin can update an existing user's details
The admin can delete a user and remove their access to the platform
The system prevents duplicate usernames

tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing users

tasks.title: Develop user management API endpoints

tasks.title: Implement user management business logic

acceptance_criteria: The admin can view real-time analytics data
The admin can view historical analytics data
The system displays key metrics such as active users and revenue
The system updates analytics data in real-time

tasks.title: Develop analytics API endpoints

acceptance_criteria: The admin can view system performance metrics such as CPU usage and memory usage
The admin can view error logs and filter by severity
The system displays system health metrics in real-time
The system sends notifications for critical system issues

tasks.title: Develop system health API endpoints

tasks.title: Implement system health monitoring and notification

stories.title: As an admin, I want to configure the platform, so that I can customize settings
stories.description: The admin should be able to configure platform settings such as notification preferences
acceptance_criteria: The admin can update notification preferences
The admin can update platform settings such as timezone and currency
The system saves configuration changes
The system applies configuration changes in real-time

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing platform configuration

tasks.title: Develop configuration API endpoints
tasks.description: Create API endpoints for retrieving and updating configuration settings

tasks.title: Implement configuration management business logic
tasks.description: Write code to handle configuration changes and apply them in real-time

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time analytics, so that I can make data-driven decisions
stories.description: The admin should be able to view real-time analytics data such as active users and revenue
acceptance_criteria: The admin can view real-time active users metric
The admin can view real-time revenue metric
The system updates real-time analytics data every minute
The system displays real-time analytics data in a user-friendly format

tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for viewing real-time analytics data
